newsitem.title: USA: Dialogic sees Q1 EPS below $0.31/shr.
newsitem.headline: Dialogic sees Q1 EPS below $0.31/shr.

text.p: Dialogic Corp said Thursday that current data indicate its first quarter 1997 sales would likely be in the $54-$57 million range, resulting in earnings falling below anaylsts' estimate of $0.31 a share.
The sales projection compares with $48.7 million posted during the first quarrter of 1996.
The projection is also below analysts' consensus forecasts as reported by First Call, the computer telephony components maker said.

It said it operates on little or no backlog and a significant amount of its orders are typically received and shipped within a day. Because of this, sales for the quarter will not be accurately determined until the final sales data for the period are complete, it said.
Edward Jordan, chief financial officer, said the year started more slowly than the company had anticipated. Expenses have so far been in line with expectations for the quarter, he added.
